village_gossip: The miller's daughter swears she saw lights out on the hills.
Prices at market have gone up again. Robbery, it is.
Old #given# claims his cow gave sour milk three days running. Bad omen, he says.
There were wolves heard howling closer than usual last week.
A stranger came through asking about old maps. Paid in strange coin.
lore_title: Saints and Wells of the #hill_region# Country
lore_text: It tells how the village was founded around a holy well, and how the well has never once run dry, not even in the year of the long drought.
Most of it concerns disputes about sheep. One chapter, oddly, describes a 'door in the earth' that the founders sealed and swore never to open.
The final pages are written in a different, shakier hand: 'When the light wanes, look to the old places. They remember.'
